name: ailocalmind-monorepo
description: Privacy-first AI desktop assistant (Sovereign AI + Normattiva build flavors). Root scripts for build orchestration.

scripts.build:sovereign: cd apps/desktop && node ../../scripts/build-brand.mjs && pnpm tauri build
scripts.build:normattiva: cd apps/desktop && VITE_BRAND=normattiva node ../../scripts/build-brand.mjs && pnpm tauri build -- --features normattiva
